divergences.detail: clip_batch_similarity: native ai/clip/model.py [POST /clip/batch-similarity] enforces field_validator('texts') capped by a module constant on a list-typed field (deployment-tunable batch/DoS guard); gateway ai/gateway/adapters/clip.py [POST /clip/batch-similarity] schema has no validator for it — the guard exists only on the (in prod: undeployed) native provider

enrich_lt_person_reid: response key sets differ — gateway-only ['embedding_dimension'] / native-only ['embedding_dim'] (ai/gateway/adapters/enrichment_light.py [POST /enrich-lt/person-reid] vs ai/enrichment-light/model.py [POST /enrich-lt/person-reid])

enrich_lt_pet_classify: response key sets differ — gateway-only ['cat_score', 'dog_score'] / native-only [] (ai/gateway/adapters/enrichment_light.py [POST /enrich-lt/pet-classify] vs ai/enrichment-light/model.py [POST /enrich-lt/pet-classify])

enrichment_enrich: response key sets differ — gateway-only ['detection_type', 'enrichments'] / native-only ['action', 'clothing', 'demographics', 'depth', 'models_used', 'pet', 'pose', 'reid_embedding', 'threat', 'vehicle'] (ai/gateway/adapters/enrichment.py [POST /enrichment/enrich] vs ai/enrichment/model.py [POST /enrichment/enrich])
